examples.label: Full name field on a checkout form
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="text-full-name" name="full_name" value="" label="Full name" placeholder="Mona Aghili" description="Enter the name exactly as it appears on your card." space="small" rounded="medium" />

examples.label: Discount code field with an apply action
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="text-discount-code" name="discount_code" value="" label="Discount code" placeholder="SPRING25" description="One code per order. Codes are not case sensitive." variant="bordered" color="natural" space="small" rounded="medium">
  <:start_section>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-tag" class="size-4 opacity-60" />
  </:start_section>
  <:end_section>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="button" variant="default" color="primary" size="extra_small" rounded="small">Apply</.component>
  </:end_section>
</.component>

examples.label: Company name with a floating label
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="text-company-floating" name="company_name" value="" label="Company name" floating="outer" variant="bordered" color="primary" rounded="medium" space="small" />
